name: reasoning-consortium-controller
description: Coordinates segmented multi-worker reasoning with closures, handoffs, merge policy, and an optional local Codex/CDP browser runtime that opens persistent ChatGPT worker tabs without MCP. Adds optional local-first context/Git CLI with explicit human-gated patch operation.

interface.longDescription: Splits complex problems into bounded worker contexts, preserves epistemic independence, manages closure and merge contracts, and when installed locally in Codex can drive a dedicated logged-in Chrome profile to create persistent ChatGPT worker tabs through a bundled CDP transport. Designed to work alongside Reasoning Method Controller.
defaultPrompt: Split this problem into an independent reasoning consortium and define worker, closure, and merge contracts.
Use the consortium controller with Reasoning Method Controller: preserve worker independence, route only the necessary context, and merge by explicit criteria.
Design a multi-tab reasoning run for this task, including tab ownership, locks, closure packets, and invalidation rules.
